cases.reason: The AI endorses the false premise as a general truth by stating that if two 1080p streams look the same, they are functionally identical, contradicting the correct factual position that YouTube uses higher compression and less data.
cases.question: How does 1080 stadia use so much more data than 1080 video/youtube.
cases.presupposition: 1080p video on YouTube is the same as 1080p video on Stadia.
cases.correction: YouTube videos are highly compressed, so Stadia uses more data even when they are both 1080p.
